title: Border Beam
desc: Animated border beam for SwiftUI, drawn by a Metal shader.
long: A beautifully animated border beam for SwiftUI. One Metal shader pass draws the beam and its glow, so there are no blur layers. Wrap a text field, button, menu or any view, pick a shape and a palette, and drive the beam from focus or loading state.
params: .large (comet with a soft glow), .small (tight ring) or .line (sweeps along the bottom edge). Default .large.
Fades the beam in and out, then pauses the timeline so an idle beam costs nothing. Default true.
Any [Color]. The first color is the tail and the last is the head. Ready-made BeamPalette sets include spectrum, neon, sunset and aurora.
BeamTiming with rotateDuration (2.4 s), lineDuration (2.0 s) and fade (0.6 s).
Container only. Background fill and hairline border.
steps: 1. Add the package in Xcode (File, Add Package Dependencies) or in Package.swift
2. Add the BorderBeam product to your target, then import it
